text: The cost of a communications link is dominated by the path rather than by the capacity, which is why multiplexing is an economic necessity.
explanation: True. Digging a trench costs the same for one fibre or 144; a submarine cable's terminal electronics are a small fraction of the ships and permits. Since the marginal cost of capacity once the path exists is near zero, every generation has re-solved the problem of getting more conversations onto paths already paid for.
